# Floor 1 against the structural drawing (generated by tools/structure_check.py)

Source: C-89 SEC-12 KHR RCC DETAILS.pdf: Agharkar Consulting Engineers Pvt Ltd, 'Layout & RCC details of foundation, column & plinth beams', drg 01, job 119926, rev R1 02.11.2026 'Revised as per after OC columns & released for construction'. M20, Fe500.

How the columns were placed: the plinth layout on the sheet has no dimensions, so it was scaled. scale 30.452 pt/m fitted to the outer column faces = 8.000 x 11.750 m (x fit 30.450, y fit 30.454); stair treads on the sheet land at X 5.75-7.84, Y 4.10-5.67, matching the architect's plan. Positions are good to about ±¾" (±0.02 m). Column sizes are from the schedule on the sheet (DRAWN). From first floor up every column is 230 mm (9") wide. The walls on floor 1 are 150 mm (6") thick, so most columns stand about 3⅛" proud of the wall on the room side.

## Result

- C12 edge falls inside window F-W1 (within the ±¾" accuracy of the scaled position; confirm on site)

## Points for the structural engineer (Agharkar Consulting Engineers) and the architect

1. **Storeys covered by the column schedule.** The schedule runs footing → plinth → first → second → third → terrace floor level: the stilt plus three floors. The architect's AFTER O.C. sheet shows the stilt plus **four** floors and a terrace. Please confirm with the structural engineer that the columns, and the footings, are designed for the fourth floor. This affects physical safety.
2. **Floor beams are not on this sheet.** Only plinth beams (PB1-PB6) are drawn. AC wall sleeves (about 7'-10½" above floor) and ceiling points still cannot be checked against beams.
3. **Floor heights are not on this sheet.** No floor-to-floor height, slab thickness, sill or lintel level is given, so the assumed 9'-10" floor-to-floor height stays ASSUMED.
4. **ROOM-1 toilet:** C10 and C16 stand about 6" into the toilet along its wall with ROOM-2. Check that the WC, geyser and pipes on that wall are set out clear of the column face.
5. **Stair:** C5 and C8 stand about 3⅛" into the stair landings at the side wall, and C7 about 3¼" into the floor landing. Check that the clear landing width still meets the architect's stair design.
6. **Lift walls C2, C3, C4** are RCC walls, 150 mm thick, and match the lift walls on the architect's plan.

Nothing structural has been changed or sized here. Only furniture and proposed points were moved to keep clear of the columns.
